headline: Independent note estimates extreme practical thresholds for OpenAI’s claimed ETH algorithm
summary: A version 1 arXiv note dated Oct 31 explains OpenAI’s claimed subexponential exact-counting result and reports that constants extracted by the authors from the Oct 25 tensor-contraction proof leave its certified running time above brute force until input sizes far beyond anything representable. The note explicitly preserves the asymptotic claim and says its separate structural limits cover the clause-product interpolation route, not the sharper parity and tensor-contraction routes. These are author-reported calculations, not independently verified results or a refutation of the headline theorem.
